name: twinery-mcp-poc
description: POC of an MCP server that lets an LLM author and iterate on branching Twine 2 stories — 15-tool authoring surface with the open / inspect / save loop, image placeholders, an LLM-facing guide resource, and a CLI-flag-selectable Streamable-HTTP transport for the connect-once dev loop (stdio remains the default; --transport http opts in). See specs/001-mcp-server-mvp/ for the full v1.0 plan.

scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:stdio && npm run smoke:http && npm run smoke:cli
